name: uci-delimited-tabular-v1
claim_ceiling: licensed development and one-time unseen public validation for byte-exact delimited tabular files; not private-holdout, independently reproduced, universal, market-leading, or state-of-the-art evidence

provider.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
provider.attribution_policy: Retain each dataset DOI, creator citation, source page, acquired archive SHA-256, selected member, and derived-item SHA-256 in every manifest.

archive_integrity_policy.state: publisher does not expose checksums on the cited pages
archive_integrity_policy.development: The frozen URL may be acquired after this split is committed. Record and commit the archive SHA-256 before using its bytes for a scored development result.
archive_integrity_policy.public_validation: Do not acquire before the candidate, implementation paths, gates, and evaluator are frozen. The first authorized acquisition records the archive and item SHA-256 values; retain the first score and do not tune on these families.

selection.slice_rule: After archive extraction and any declared member decompression, retain the complete file when it is at most max_item_bytes. Otherwise retain the longest prefix of at most max_item_bytes that ends immediately after LF. Do not parse, normalize, transcode, reserialize, or change line endings.
selection.member_rule: Match the complete normalized archive member path exactly. Reject duplicate, absent, absolute, parent-traversing, symbolic-link, or non-regular members.
selection.item_rule: One selected source member is one benchmark family and one exact byte stream.
